shared_elements: low-relief carved stelae with figural scene
script signs / glyph blocks integrated with the figures
held objects/staff or emblem in figure's hands
upper zone of inscription above/beside figures
justification: Both are upright slab monuments carved in low relief showing human figures in profile with elaborate headdresses, holding objects, accompanied by blocks of script signs placed above and beside them — a broadly shared 'inscribed figural stela' scheme. But the specific forms differ markedly: A shows a seated enthroned figure with a smaller attendant offering, rendered in clean flowing linear outline with clear anatomy, while B shows a standing, densely ornamented figure whose costume, plumes and glyph blocks fill the field in a much more crowded, blocky and geometricised manner.
